CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rs_auth_find_invitation_tenant(p_hash text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
            SELECT i.tenant_id FROM invitations i
            WHERE i.token_hash = p_hash AND i.used_at IS NULL AND i.revoked_at IS NULL
              AND i.expires_at > now()
        $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rs_auth_find_refresh_tenant(p_hash text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ SELECT r.tenant_id FROM refresh_tokens r WHERE r.token_hash = p_hash $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rs_auth_find_user(p_email text)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, tenant_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id FROM users u WHERE u.email = lower(p_email) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rs_platform_tenant()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ SELECT t.id FROM tenants t WHERE t.is_platform ORDER BY t.created_at LIMIT 1 $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rs_tenant_id_by_slug(p_slug text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ SELECT t.id FROM tenants t WHERE t.slug = p_slug $function$
